def read_system(tar, label):
    edge, state = SOURCES[label]
    base = f'Systems/{label[0]}Series/{edge}/Complex/core/'
    raw = {f: tar.extractfile(base+f).read() for f in ['SYSTEM.pdb','SYSTEM.top','MORPH.pert']}
    top = topology(raw['SYSTEM.top'].decode())
    pdb = [s for s in raw['SYSTEM.pdb'].decode().splitlines() if s.startswith(('ATOM  ','HETATM'))]
    names = top['ATOM_NAME']; types = top['AMBER_ATOM_TYPE']
    assert len(pdb) == len(names) == top['POINTERS'][0]
    assert [s[12:16].strip() for s in pdb] == names
    nlig = top['RESIDUE_POINTER'][1]-1
    coords = np.array([[float(s[a:b]) for a,b in [(30,38),(38,46),(46,54)]] for s in pdb])
